Trust.title: Trade with care
Trust.body: Publication is a moderation check, not buyer protection or fitment approval. Ask for current photos and part numbers. Use protected payment; never send gift cards or cryptocurrency.
Trust.contact: Keep contact and payment details out of public listings. Use the private inbox.
